metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the tool in [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It covers `.bib` parsing, `.bst` parsing/interpreting, cite extraction from `--cites` and `--aux`, crossref inheritance and parent auto-inclusion, BibTeX-style output wrapping, and the requested JSON log/error outputs.

Verified by building and running sample `plain`, `alpha`, `abbrv`, and `unsrt` cases, plus warning and failure paths. Build check was run from `output/` with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`.
